test_open_notification_panel.title: Verify clicking the notification bell opens the notification panel.

steps.action: Log in to the application with valid credentials
steps.expected: User is logged in and default page loads

steps.action: Trigger an LPR event or ensure an LPR notification exists
steps.expected: An LPR notification appears in the notification area

steps.action: Click the notification bell icon to open the notification panel
steps.expected: Notification panel opens showing recent notifications

steps.action: Locate and click the LPR notification entry
Verify a video preview loads within the notification panel
steps.expected: Video preview displays the LPR event footage inline

steps.action: Verify the video preview shows the correct LPR event details
steps.expected: License plate data and timestamp match the notification
Panel closes cleanly, returning to the previous view

test_mute_notifications.title: The mute control in the notification panel toggles and toggles back

steps.action: Open the notification panel and read the mute icon.
steps.expected: The icon shows the current state, Mute or UnMute.
The icon changes to the other state.
The icon returns to the state it started in.

test_admin_mute_rule_notification.title: Verify a rule notification can be muted from Admin > General > Rules

steps.expected: The rules are listed, each with a Mute Notification icon.

steps.action: Click a rule's Mute Notification icon.
steps.expected: The icon changes to Unmute Notification.
